controls.text: Pitch and Roll do not work yet. ->
Load default window positions with maps
Center on camera after movement in 3D
Use Visgroup colors for object lines

views.text: Four views: 3D (camera) top-left, top (x/y) top-right, front (y/z) bottom-left, side (x/z) bottom-right. The document's view list (layer 2) gives each view's HWND at CWnd +0x1c.

steps: WM_COMMAND 0xE100 (File/New)
dialog 'Select a game' (title set at run time) appears: press OK (id 1)
the new document becomes the active one (title 'Map1')
WM_COMMAND 0x802C (Block tool)
drag in a 2D view: WM_LBUTTONDOWN / WM_MOUSEMOVE (MK_LBUTTON) / WM_LBUTTONUP sent to the view's HWND work

Enter creates the solid: it needs real keyboard focus on that view (foreground + SetFocus, then a real key press) AND the mouse cursor over that view; a WM_KEYDOWN / WM_CHAR sent to the view is ignored
a second drag before Enter resizes the pending box instead of starting a new one
create_block.notes: height comes from the previous block (64 on a new map); the new solid is selected and gets the current texture

steps: select solids
WM_COMMAND 0x8098 (Ctrl+H)
dialog 198, title 'Hollow' (set at run time): wall thickness in Edit 1009 (negative = outward), OK id 1
make_hollow.notes: the result is a group of wall solids; the selection is empty afterwards

steps: select objects
WM_COMMAND 0x0071 (Ctrl+M)
dialog 114 'Transformation': mode radios 1274 Rotate / 1259 Scale / 1194 Move (click with BM_CLICK), values X/Y/Z in Edit 114 / 115 / 116, OK id 1
transform.notes: Scale is about the selection centre

steps: WM_COMMAND 0x806B (Edit/Select all), 0x8061 clears the selection
select_all.notes: on a big map Hammer can freeze for a long time (redraw): ask the user first

steps: WM_MOUSEWHEEL sent to the 3D view moves the camera along its forward vector (~60 units per notch)
arrow keys turn / tilt the camera only with real keyboard focus on the 3D view
Camera tool WM_COMMAND 0x8041 (Shift+C): a drag in a 2D view (messages sent to it) puts the 3D camera at the start point looking at the end point; z stays the view's current depth
camera.notes: a click in the top-left corner of a view opens its view-type menu ('camera' label)

object_bar.text: Right-hand 'New Objects' bar (live): ComboBox 1010 Categories, ComboBox 1007 Objects. Block tool: categories Primitives + prefab libraries, objects block / wedge / cylinder / spike / arch, Edit 1009 + spin 1008 = faces. Entity tool: category '(entities)', objects = point classes of the FGD (142 for Half-Life). Select a class: CB_SETCURSEL + WM_COMMAND CBN_SELCHANGE to the combo's parent. Buttons 32873 'to World', 1110 'to Entity', 32933 'Create Prefab'.

texture_bar.text: 'Textures' bar (live): ComboBox 1007 current texture is owner-drawn (no strings: item data are pointers; read the names from the WADs), Static 1027 size ('16x16'), Button 1010 Browse..., ComboBox 1158 texture group ('All Textures' + each WAD path), Button 1257 Replace...

steps: WM_COMMAND 0x8030 (Entity tool)
pick the class in the object bar (ComboBox 1007)
click in a 2D view (WM_LBUTTONDOWN/UP sent to it) - a marker appears
Enter with real keyboard focus on that view and the cursor over it creates the entity (selected)
a click in a 2D view inside a group selects the whole group (the hollow room), not the entity in it
reliable: Map/Entity report (0x80E4) -> list 1318 (multi-select: LB_SETSEL, then WM_COMMAND LBN_SELCHANGE) -> Mark (1303) selects the entity

entity_report.text: dialog 234 'Entity Report' (modeless): ListBox 1318 entities (class names); filter radios 1192 Everything / 1134 Brush entities / 1135 Point entities; check 1310 include hidden; 1306 by key/value (Edit 1308 key, 1309 value, check 1324 exact); 1319 by class (ComboBox 1007, every FGD class incl. brush ones - 192 for Half-Life); buttons 1303 Mark, 1304 Go to, 1305 Delete, 1311 Properties, 1 Close

steps: select objects, WM_COMMAND 0x8033 (Alt+Enter): modeless property sheet 'Object Properties' (it follows the selection while open)
pages: entity = Class Info (+ Flags when the class has spawnflags) + VisGroup; group / solid = VisGroup only
switch page: TCM_SETCURFOCUS on the tab control 12320 (PSM_SETCURSEL does not switch it)
with several objects selected the entity page shows a Flags tab and SmartEdit is off: the raw keyvalues list (e.g. _light, _fade, style, _falloff)
object_properties.text: Class Info page (dialog 106): ComboBox 1030 class (the entity's class list), check 1119 SmartEdit, ListBox 1024 attributes (SmartEdit names from the FGD, e.g. Target, Name, Brightness...), Edit 1009 key / Edit 1106 value + buttons 1033 add, 1032 delete (shown with SmartEdit off), 1263 copy, 1354 paste, 1396 Pick color; Yaw combo 1107 (Up / Down + angle), Pitch 1110 / Roll 1111 ('do not work yet'). VisGroup page (dialog 148): ListBox 1097 groups, button 1091 Edit groups.

steps: WM_COMMAND 0x8087 (F9). An unsaved map first gets a Save As dialog (Cancel = no Run Map); a saved map opens 'Run Map'

'Run Map' (dialog 185): radios CSG 1136 No / 1139 Normal / 1170 Entities only; BSP 1137 No / 1169 Normal; VIS 1455 No / 1456 Normal / 1457 Fast; RAD 1458 No / 1140 Normal / 1141 Extra; checks 1138 Don't run the game, 1142 Save visible objects only; Edit 1161 additional game parameters; 1226 Expert; OK 1 starts the compile, Cancel 2

'Run Map [Advanced]' (dialog 215, from Expert): ComboBox 1212 configuration (from CmdSeq.wc), ListBox 1240 commands (e.g. 'Change Directory $exedir', '$csg_exe $path\$file ...', 'Copy File ...'), buttons 1093 New / 1085 Remove / 1237 Up / 1241 Down / 1247 Edit configurations; selected command: Edit 1239 command + 1238 Cmds, Edit 1079 parameters + 1243 Parms, checks 1244 long filenames, 1245 ensure file post-exists (Edit 1246), 1262 process window, 1261 visible objects only; 1 Go! (runs), 2 Cancel, 1227 Normal
run_map.notes: never press OK / Go! without the user: it compiles and may start the game

steps: WM_COMMAND 0x8066 (Tools/Options...): modal property sheet 'Configure Valve Hammer Editor', 6 pages, switch with TCM_SETCURFOCUS on tab control 12320; Cancel = id 2

pages.General: 1338 load default window positions, 1339 independent window configurations, Edit 1189 undo levels, 1401 allow (un)grouping while Ignore Groups, 1402 stretch arches
pages.2D views: checks 1154 crosshair cursor, 1163 15-degree rotations, 1165 scrollbars, 1166 draw vertices, 1225 white-on-black, 1295 keep group when clone-dragging, 1331 center on camera after 3D movement, 1351 visgroup colours, 1281 arrow keys nudge selection, 1282 reorient primitives, 1283 automatic infinite selection (no ENTER), 1285 select by center handles only, 1156 group carved fragments; grid: ComboBox 1007 default grid (4..256), 1270 + Edit 1290 highlight every N lines, 1321 highlight every 64, 1465 every 1024, 1271 hide small grid, 1322 dotted
pages.3D views: trackbar 1283 back clipping plane (Static 1284 value), 1452 filter textures, 1416 animate models, trackbar 1414 model render distance (1415), 1402 mouselook navigation, 1221 reverse mouse Y, trackbars 1424 forward speed (1426) / 1425 time to top speed (1427), 1460 reverse selection order, 1466 background colour
pages.Textures: ListBox 1010 texture WADs (the registry list General\TextureFile0..N), 1151 Add WAD, 1152 Remove, trackbar 1159 brightness
pages.Game Configurations: ComboBox 1212 configuration (GameCfg.wc), 1247 Edit configurations, ListBox 1209 FGDs + 1210 Add / 1215 Edit / 1211 Remove, ComboBox 1395 texture format, 1396 map type, ComboBox 1007 default point entity, 1008 default solid entity (brush classes), Edit 1453 game executable directory, 1012 mod directory, 1010 game directory, 1011 RMF directory (+ Browse buttons)
pages.Build Programs: ComboBox 1391 configuration, Edit 1009 game executable, 1019 CSG, 1011 BSP, 1133 VIS, 1132 RAD, 1400 place compiled maps in this directory (each with Browse / Parms)

steps: click in the view first (it becomes the active view), then View/3D Wireframe 0x800A, 3D Filled 0x8016, 3D Textured 0x8009; a new map's 3D view starts in wireframe, where clicks do not hit faces
select a solid, then WM_COMMAND 0x8091 (Shift+A, Texture application) - it TOGGLES the mode: send it once
the mode selects every face of the selected solids and opens 'Face Properties' (an MFC frame, class Afx:...; the dialog inside is id 59405) while the right-hand Textures bar hides
clicking a face in a TEXTURED 3D view selects that face
send 0x8091 again (or another tool) to leave the mode
face_edit.text: Face Properties (dialog 194): scale X/Y Edit 1009 / 1150, shift X/Y 1149 / 1144, rotation 1023 (spins next to them), justify buttons 1404 L / 1407 R / 1406 Fit / 1403 T / 1411 B / 1405 C, check 1410 treat as one, align radios 1408 World / 1409 Face, ComboBox 1158 texture group, ComboBox 1007 current texture (owner-drawn), Static 1027 size, buttons 1015 Apply (puts the current texture on the selected faces), 1010 Browse..., 1257 Replace..., 1274 mode (Lift+Select ...), check 1294 hide mask; Contents / Surface checks (1440-1449) exist but are hidden in GoldSrc

steps: Browse... (1010) on Face Properties or the Textures bar opens 'Textures' (dialog 246)
type a filter into Edit 1001 (child of ComboBox 1269) and send WM_COMMAND EN_CHANGE to its parent
double-click a tile in the child window 'TextureBrowserWindow' (id 106; WM_LBUTTONDBLCLK sent to it, first tile at about 40,40) - the texture becomes current and the browser closes
then Apply (1015) in Face Properties
texture_browser.text: also: check 1289 only used textures, 1303 Mark (selects faces with the texture), 1257 Replace, ComboBox 1027 tile size (1:1 / 32 / 64 / 128), Static 1267 / 1268 name and size of the highlighted texture

check_problems.text: Map/Check for Problems 0x80A2 (Alt+P): dialog 202 'Check map for problems' - ListBox 1122 problems (e.g. 'There is no player start.'), Edit 1009 description, buttons 1187 Go to error, 1277 Fix, 1278 Fix all (of type), 1 Close

map_information.text: Map/Show Information 0x8094: dialog 197 'Map Information' - Static 1164 solids, 1165 point entities, 1166 solid entities, 1009 faces, 1419 unique textures, 1420 texture memory, ListBox 1421 WADs used; 1 Close

windows.text: What each command / button opens (live, Hammer 3.5 with a small map): title at run time, 'dialog' = resource id in 'dialogs', 'message' = it is a message box (read its text at run time). Close dialogs with Cancel (2) or their own Close / OK (1) - never send WM_CLOSE repeatedly: that crashed Hammer 3.5 on 'Run Map Configurations'. Common file dialogs (Open, Save As, Export, Load Pointfile, Add WAD / FGD) are the system ones.

0xE100 File/New.title: Select a game
0xE100 File/New.note: same template as 'Edit Game Configurations' (272) with another title; OK (1) picks the configuration

0xE130 Window/New Window.note: main window title -> Valve Hammer Editor - [newroom.rmf:2]

0xE132 Window/Cascade.note: main window title -> Valve Hammer Editor - newroom.rmf

0x80A4 Prefab Factory / button 1199.note: no new window (maybe a popup menu or nothing)

0x8066 Configure / button 1215.note: no new window (maybe a popup menu or nothing)

traps.text: Edit/Cut, Delete, Paste, Tools/Carve act at once on the selection (no dialog); File/Save saves silently and keeps the previous file as <map>.rmx; Window/New Window opens a second view window of the same map; Edit/Disable Undo/Redo toggles without a dialog; Help items launch hammer.chm ('Failed to launch help.' when it is missing); File/New and File/Open ask 'Select a game' first; Run Map on an unsaved map opens Save As first; Process.MainWindowHandle of Hammer can be a dialog - find the main frame by class VALVE_EDITOR. The Build Programs Parms / Browse buttons and Run Map [Advanced] Cmds / Parms open popup menus, not windows.
